caseNameFull: DaimlerChrysler Corp. v. Cuno and Wilkins, Tax Commissioner for the State of Ohio v. Cuno

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. In addition to the questions presented by the petitions, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: “Whether respondents have standing to challenge Ohio's investment tax credit, Ohio Rev. Code Ann. §5733.33?” Reported below: 386 F. 3d 738.
